# cb:b463

> Belief ids are namespaced as `namespace:local-id` (e.g. `cb:b038`, `agent-behavior:a054`), with exactly one owning collection per namespace, so ids are globally unique. Deps may cross namespaces and resolve globally, but `cb:` depends only within `cb:`; every other collection may depend on `cb:`. The separator is `:`.
